# Linux: two real immutable attempt domains, one logical job.
skygo --json jobs retention
domain DOMAIN
taskfile task.json failonce
controller start
skygo --json run -f task.json --request-domain $DOMAIN --request-id retry --wait
json-value id JOB
skygo --json jobs get $JOB
history-attempts $JOB FIRST_ATTEMPT SECOND_ATTEMPT
cp stdout history.json
skygo --json jobs logs $JOB --attempt 1
attempt-logs $FIRST_ATTEMPT 'first attempt only' 'second attempt only'
cursor FIRST_CURSOR
skygo --json jobs logs $JOB --attempt 2
attempt-logs $SECOND_ATTEMPT 'second attempt only' 'first attempt only'
cursor SECOND_CURSOR
# Actual returned cursors stay pinned to the selected IDs even at EOF.
skygo --json jobs logs $JOB --cursor $FIRST_CURSOR
attempt-logs $FIRST_ATTEMPT
skygo --json jobs logs $JOB --cursor $SECOND_CURSOR
attempt-logs $SECOND_ATTEMPT
cmp starts two-starts.txt
skygo --json jobs prune --before 9999-12-31T23:59:59Z --logs-only --yes
stdout '"marked": *1'
! skygo jobs logs $JOB --attempt 1
stderr 'logs expired'
! skygo jobs logs $JOB --attempt 2
stderr 'logs expired'
skygo --json jobs get $JOB
same-json history.json
await-output-usage 0
assert-native 0

-- two-starts.txt --
start
start
